source: in-session Claude Code agent (pred-scout-coach) over data/omeda/heroes.json ability text only; every number ground-checked against the ability, failing lines dropped

wraith.E: Camouflage before repositioning or escaping — takedowns reset it, so look for the next angle after every kill.
wraith.LMB: Shoot constantly between sniper shots — his basic attacks carry heavy scaling and finish what the mark starts.
wraith.RMB: Snipe marked targets — the cooldown mostly refunds on marked hits, so grenade first, then fire again.
wraith.Q: Open with the grenade — the mark reveals the target and supercharges the next sniper shot against their health.
wraith.R: Send divers or overextended enemies back to where they stood — cast early, since the teleport takes time to trigger.
wraith.Passive: Plant the drone on ridges and walls — it spots heroes through terrain, turning fog fights into free information.

wukong.LMB: Keep swinging on heroes — repeated hits spawn Clones, adding chaos and extra damage.
wukong.RMB: Spirit: dash through targets to engage and slow. Body: shove divers off allies with the extended staff.
wukong.Q: Body: leap in with the attack speed for trades. Spirit: cloud-walk the team over walls toward objectives.
wukong.E: Spirit: spin for damage reduction while closing, then throw the stun. Body: slam from high ground for maximum damage.
wukong.R: Swap stances mid-combo to double the available abilities, and keep hitting so Clones spawn throughout the fight.
wukong.Passive: Double-jump to dodge skillshots, cross walls, or set up the high-ground slam from above.

zinx.LMB: Keep tagging heroes — the stacking damage-over-time makes her poke stronger than it looks.
zinx.RMB: Heal the ally who is lowest — the bolt heals more the lower they are, so avoid topping people off.
zinx.Q: Throw the disk into clumped enemies — each ricochet is another stun, and even the shorter ones interrupt everything.
zinx.E: Paint the ground under divers or chokepoints — the double eruption plus slow zones off a whole angle.
zinx.R: Grant Revival to the carry diving or being dived before the damage lands — used late, it is wasted.
zinx.Passive: Poke heroes to full stacks, then pump the boosted Infuse into whoever is in trouble during the free-movement window.

kallari.R: Dive from an off-angle onto wounded targets — damage climbs to 2.5x on missing health, so finish with it, not open.
kallari.LMB: Attack from behind after the daggers land; melee pressure plus the mark closes out short trades.
kallari.RMB: Throw daggers to soften targets before committing; with two charges, spend one for damage and keep one to slow escapes.
kallari.Q: Enter stealth before the fight, not during — attacking breaks it — and use the speed to reach the backline.
kallari.E: Backflip to dodge damage, then dash onto a target carrying Death Mark for double damage.
kallari.Passive: Tag a target and let the mark detonate before diving, and use the extra jumps to reach hidden carries.

grim-exe.LMB: Trade with steady shots — every hit loads the burst that pops Pulsefire.
grim-exe.RMB: Save the shield for the enemy's key ability — the hook, stun, or snipe — and bank mana for blocking it.
grim-exe.Q: In Assault Mode, lob it over minions to shove enemies out of position; otherwise fire it straight in trades.
grim-exe.E: Farm and trade in Sentry Mode for stacking attack speed; swap to Assault for long-range sieging when mana allows.
grim-exe.R: Fire when the target's teammates cannot body-block the line — it only stops on heroes, so catch them isolated.
grim-exe.Passive: Alternate attacks and abilities — each Pulsefire burst is free true damage, so pop it instead of stacking hits blindly.

the-fey.LMB: Poke with basic attacks between plant casts; they fill the mana-free gaps.
the-fey.RMB: Hurl it where enemies must stand — half the damage comes from the explosion, so make them sit in it.
the-fey.Q: Lay the brambles across chokepoints and escape routes; enemies either eat damage walking through or surrender the path.
the-fey.E: Spam it at one target — repeat hits stack bonus damage, and hero hits refund most of the mana.
the-fey.R: Plant it amid grouped enemies — the delayed pull and stun set up every ally, so cast with the team ready.
the-fey.Passive: Chase with the takedown speed boost — the corpse-plant covers the retreat or fuels the next kill.

lt-belica.Q: Send the wave down escape routes or under divers — the knock-up stun stops dashes and channels alike.
lt-belica.LMB: Poke in bursts between spells; steady chip forces enemies to spend mana answering.
lt-belica.RMB: Place the bomb where enemies must stand — under the wave or a choke — and collect mana per enemy hit.
lt-belica.E: Deploy the drone into fights near casters — it drains mana and zaps every cast, taxing ability-hungry enemies.
lt-belica.R: Fire it at drained, mana-starved targets — the damage rises with missing mana, so drone first, blast second.
lt-belica.Passive: Max abilities fully in a deliberate order — each finished ability adds haste and unlocks its stronger Innovation effect.

khaimera.LMB: Keep hitting anything nearby — every swing adds Rage, which speeds cooldowns and fuels the next leap.
khaimera.RMB: Leap onto wounded targets — the damage doubles on missing health — and use the slow to stay glued.
khaimera.Q: Cast it right after landing on a target; maximum attack speed for 5 attacks melts anyone standing still.
khaimera.E: Hold it to cleanse the stun that would kill — the heal plus brief immunity turns dives into won duels.
khaimera.R: Channel when several enemies line up — the stun sets up allies, and every hero hit refunds Rage.
khaimera.Passive: Never idle — Rage decays quickly after a pause; chain camps and trades to keep the speed and cooldowns rolling.

gideon.RMB: Throw the comet at escaping enemies — it explodes on the first hero and slows, making the meteor easy to land.
gideon.Q: Drop the meteor on slowed or tethered enemies; lead the aim so they walk into the impact.
gideon.E: Leap over walls to escape or start picks; leave the portal open so teammates can follow through.
gideon.R: Ult after enemies burn their dashes; after channelling 2.75s it cannot be cancelled and keeps dragging them in.
gideon.Passive: Land an ability, then immediately basic attack — the tether damages over time and roots, chaining into the next ability.
gideon.LMB: Keep attacking between spells; each ability-empowered attack adds damage and sets up the tether root.

drongo.LMB: Keep firing at one target — critical hits apply the bleed, so steady attacks melt tanks too.
drongo.RMB: Bounce the boomerang off walls so it hits twice; the double slow sets up everything else.
drongo.Q: Silence divers and channelers with the gas grenade; toss it onto their frontline before they can answer.
drongo.E: Activate before trades — stack the irradiation with attacks, then detonate it instantly with the boomerang or bazooka.
drongo.R: Shoot it through their team for the armor shred, or fire mid-air backwards to escape ganks with the launch.
drongo.Passive: Build critical strike and keep hitting the frontline — the maximum-health bleed punishes big health bars.

iggy-scorch.RMB: Molotov the oil to ignite it; otherwise throw it at chokepoints so the fire field ticks fully.
iggy-scorch.Q: Tuck turrets behind corners and walls near objectives — melee attacks chew them up — then feed them targets with basic attacks.
iggy-scorch.E: Roll the oil down chokepoints and light it — the refreshed slow plus burn zones off the whole path.
iggy-scorch.R: Open the cone on grouped enemies, walk with the speed boost, and belch late to knock divers away.
iggy-scorch.Passive: Slick targets with basic attacks first — igniting oil-covered enemies is where the real burn damage lives.
iggy-scorch.LMB: Spit at chasers to stack the slow, and tag targets so the turrets switch onto them.

steel.LMB: Mix light and heavy punches on whoever is stunned; the heavy hits carry the damage.
steel.RMB: Bash tanks too — it deals a slice of their maximum health — and use the stun to interrupt channels.
steel.Q: Charge through their line to knock the backline out of position; being Unstoppable means nobody can stop the engage.
steel.E: Drop the wall between allies and enemy shooters; it blocks every projectile for 4s and punishes whoever walks through.
steel.R: Leap onto grouped enemies to start fights — the knock-up and stun hand the team a free window.
steel.Passive: Back off when the shield breaks; a short spell out of danger refreshes it before the next trade.

legion.LMB: Build penetration — the rifle hits harder for every point owned — and pause firing to let the ammo replenish.
legion.RMB: Cook the grenade to shorten the fuse — never fully, it detonates in hand — and blast divers or launch Legion himself.
legion.Q: Fire the payload at chokepoints or fights and reactivate to deploy — the mine field chunks and slows anyone holding ground.
legion.E: Plant the standard as the fight starts — allies heal and speed up, enemy wards get revealed, and ammo never runs dry.
legion.R: Lob it onto grouped enemies in a locked fight — the beam tracks heroes, so pair it with allied crowd control.
legion.Passive: Itemize deliberately — power, penetration, haste, and magic power each unlock a listed bonus, so build toward the wanted effect.

boris.Q: Sniff before invading — the trail's speed closes distance, and hitting the marked target banks a free Canister.
boris.LMB: Keep clubbing one target — every second hit banks a Canister, feeding attack speed and healing.
boris.RMB: Dash through the target so both swipes connect; the doubled on-hit effects are the point.
boris.E: Pop the barrier as damage comes in, walk forward behind the damage reduction, and detonate late for the longest fear.
boris.R: Grab the enemy backline and slam them into allies; the leap also carries a target away from their support.
boris.Passive: Stay on one target at max Canisters — the Core's zaps and healing decide long brawls, so avoid dropping stacks.

phase.LMB: Poke with basic attacks while linked; small ranged hits add up when abilities are down.
phase.RMB: Link the carry before fights; pull them out of danger early — once they are immobilized, the pull no longer works.
phase.Q: Flash it when divers face Phase or her partner — the blind blanks their damage during the crucial second.
phase.E: Hold the beam on one chaser — the stacking slow becomes a root if they keep running at the team.
phase.R: Save it for the committed fight; overcharging the linked carry's attack speed and haste decides extended brawls.
phase.Passive: Cast something on cooldown for the healing drip, and remember the cheap, fast-returning Blink makes aggressive positioning affordable.

murdock.LMB: Farm and poke from maximum range; steady shots build toward the empowered long-range attack.
murdock.RMB: Fire it point-blank for full damage and the strongest push-back; the armor shred makes follow-up shots hurt.
murdock.Q: Trap chokepoints, jungle entrances, and escape paths; a rooted target during a gank rarely survives.
murdock.E: Activate before trades and stack it on takedowns — the reset keeps the attack speed rolling through whole fights.
murdock.R: Snipe fleeing low-health enemies through walls; line the shot through several targets since it ignores physical armor.
murdock.Passive: Land 5 attacks on the wave, then poke the enemy with the extended-range empowered shot for free damage.

terra.LMB: Weave basic attacks between abilities to build Hersir stacks fast; each hit brings the next Empowered ability closer.
terra.RMB: Channel briefly before dashing — the first 1.25s adds range and damage; engage with the Empowered version for a free shield.
terra.Q: Spin in the middle of several enemies; hero hits refund cooldown, and the Empowered third strike shreds high-health targets.
terra.E: Poke with the axe before trading — it slows and cuts physical armor; save the Empowered root to lock down escapes.
terra.R: Cast when diving towers — it disables them, cleanses debuffs, and slows everyone nearby, so commit right after activating.
terra.Passive: Leave base with maximum stacks ready; plan which ability gets Empowered before every fight, and hug towers for extra armor.

skylar.RMB: Activate it in every real trade — the fixed rapid fire and armor bypass shred, and takedowns refresh it mid-fight.
skylar.Q: Stick the bubble on a hero before committing — the delayed blast and heavy slow set up the hypercharged spray.
skylar.E: Hover above walls or the brawl for extra range and free missiles — but pick the landing spot first.
skylar.R: Save the orb for wounded heroes — it stops on the first one hit and scales off their missing health.
skylar.LMB: Keep firing at one target — Starfire delivers every buff Skylar stacks.
skylar.Passive: Finish low targets standing beside their allies — hero explosions are far bigger and chunk everyone nearby.

kira.RMB: Weave Mercy between attacks — it stacks Vengeance 3 at a time and can crit, so use it on cooldown.
kira.LMB: Keep attacking a single target to pile up Vengeance before purging with Dusk.
kira.Q: Stack Vengeance high before pressing it — the burst grows per stack, and a kill resets the cooldown for chains.
kira.E: Dash to reposition, not to engage; the stacking power and takedown resets reward aggressive-but-alive play.
kira.R: Channel it when enemies are on top of Kira and committed — the healing cut and crits shred divers.
kira.Passive: Spend the empowered Raven shot on high-health targets — it burns current health, so open trades with it.

maco.LMB: Weave basic attacks between casts — they carry 55% of your power, so they are never just filler.
maco.RMB: Throw the gem long — the stun grows with distance travelled — or detonate it early point-blank to peel divers.
maco.Q: Toss it at whoever needs it most — it heals and speeds allies but damages enemies, so it always has value.
maco.E: Leap onto an enemy hero for the shield, then slide out with the landing dash; it is engage and escape in one.
maco.R: Charge it fully from range — the gemstone drags enemies along, and the final explosion stuns longest on full charge.
maco.Passive: Keep moving between casts; at full stacks Maco ignores slows, so route around fights instead of standing still.

revenant.LMB: Count the shots — the final round always crits, so land it on the hero, not the wave.
revenant.RMB: Save the final round for wounded targets — the missing-health bonus and speed burst reward finishing trades with it.
revenant.Q: Mark with Scar first — the missiles then focus the marked hero instead of spraying into minions.
revenant.E: Lead with the orb, then keep hitting — each hit consumes a mark, ending in a root for the finish.
revenant.R: Drag the enemy carry into the Nether Realm once their escape is down; isolated, power-drained targets rarely walk out.
revenant.Passive: Build critical chance and attack speed — both directly raise his power — and hunt kills for the stacking bounty gold.

yin.RMB: Hold it for enemy projectiles — the reflect turns hooks and snipes around — or shove divers off allies.
yin.Q: Pull to a target or the wall behind them, land the heavy slow, then pick the leap direction that traps them.
yin.E: Activate for whip range and cleave before fights; every third hit chunks maximum health and heals.
yin.R: Cast it into enemy poke — halted projectiles blank ranged carries while Yin closes the gap inside the winds.
yin.LMB: Stay glued to targets — every hit builds attack speed stacks, so uninterrupted swinging snowballs.
yin.Passive: Never stop attacking — the stacks decay fast, and full stacks are a huge attack-speed lead in duels.

argus.LMB: Poke with basic attacks while mana recovers — the beam is hungry and basics are free.
argus.RMB: Hold the stream on one target — the homing blasts stack his passive fast, and at maximum rank it never stops.
argus.Q: Lob the stun onto enemies locked in animations or fighting allies — everything else combos off this landing.
argus.E: Drop the crystal into the middle of a brawl — push, storm, then the implosion drags them back into the damage.
argus.R: Channel from behind the frontline at wounded targets — the beams hit harder the lower they are, so it finishes fights.
argus.Passive: Chain abilities quickly on the same target — every stack makes the next hit bigger, so never pause mid-combo.

mourn.LMB: Trade with basic attacks when Extract is loaded; the bonus hit and its healing win close exchanges.
mourn.RMB: Wind up from fog or behind minions; the longer the channel, the farther the reach — grab the backline carry.
mourn.Q: Vomit the bugs onto the frontline clash — allies heal and gain armor while enemies take damage and lose theirs.
mourn.E: Channel while walking at enemies — the damage reduction covers the approach; release late for the longest daze.
mourn.R: Use it before a pick or objective fight — enemies lose vision map-wide while Mourn speeds in with Contagion applied.
mourn.Passive: Open trades with the empowered attack; it hits everyone in range and restores health on damage.

grux.LMB: Keep swinging on a single target; the stacking bleed from repeated hits wins extended trades.
grux.RMB: Cleave the wave and the hero together; hitting heroes or camp leaders heals more the lower Grux's health.
grux.Q: Channel longer for extra range, then pull the carry into the team; attack instantly during the stun.
grux.E: Charge through a hero to drag them along — deliver them to allies or away from their escape route.
grux.R: Pop it mid-fight with several enemies close — the stun interrupts, and the stolen power snowballs long brawls.
grux.Passive: Stick to one victim; the bleed stacks up to 6 times, so uninterrupted attacks hit far harder than split targets.

bayle.LMB: Finish the swing chain — the last hit carries 2.3x damage, so never cancel it early.
bayle.RMB: Leap onto the carry — the armor shred plus bonus speed toward marked targets makes sticking easy; cancel early to slam instantly.
bayle.Q: Land all 3 slashes on the same target — the final knock-up plus bonus bleed pays off committed swings.
bayle.E: Howl at the start of exchanges — the power and omnivamp during, plus the heal after, wins extended trades.
bayle.R: Dash in a straight line at an isolated target — it stops on the first hero, so never ult into their frontline.
bayle.Passive: Fights turn when Bayle drops low — the Berserk attack-speed spike rewards staying in rather than fleeing at low health.

morigesh.LMB: Keep flicking daggers at poisoned targets to refresh the damage-over-time between ability rotations.
morigesh.RMB: Mark the enemy carry early and keep it running — hits on them heal Morigesh, and her ultimate needs the Mark.
morigesh.Q: Open trades with the hive — the heavy decaying slow makes everything else easy to land.
morigesh.E: Swarm through the whole enemy team — hitting a hero fully refreshes it, so chain passes to heal and escape.
morigesh.R: After Marking a priority target, channel the curse to finish them — but remember casting removes the Mark.
morigesh.Passive: Rotate abilities onto tanks — the stacking poison burns maximum health — and refresh it with daggers instead of over-casting.

muriel.LMB: Poke between shields; steady orb attacks make the lane trades honest.
muriel.RMB: Charge past 1.1s for the stun version and release it on divers, or cancel to refund half.
muriel.Q: Drop it under the team during objective fights — allies attack faster and heal while enemies inside slow down.
muriel.E: Throw the shield ahead of incoming damage, not after; the speed boost also helps allies dodge or chase.
muriel.R: Watch the whole map — save it to land on an ally being dived, arriving with a shield and knock-up.
muriel.Passive: Poke healers' targets first — her ability damage cuts enemy healing — and buff allies to boost their heals and shields.

greystone.LMB: Trade freely in melee — heavy swings between abilities carry his duels.
greystone.RMB: Leap onto heroes — hitting one refunds a big cut of the cooldown, so aggressive jumps come back fast.
greystone.Q: Spin it on top of the brawl — the stacking armor shred makes the whole team's physical damage hit harder.
greystone.E: Empower the blade before poking — the extended cleaving hit and slow win trades before they start.
greystone.R: Ult at low health in the middle of enemies — the stasis heal grows with missing health — then crash down.
greystone.Passive: Trade right after the deflect absorbs a hit, and remember Greystone only gets tougher as his health drops.

rampage.LMB: Punch whoever the boulder stunned; basic attacks fill the gaps while abilities recharge.
rampage.RMB: Leap onto the backline and knock them toward allies; carry a boulder first so it shatters on landing.
rampage.Q: Hold the boulder while closing distance — up to 5s — then throw it point-blank for an easy stun.
rampage.E: Use it in every scrap — short cooldown, a slow on everyone nearby, and its passive rewards leveling it.
rampage.R: Activate in the middle of their team — the healing rises for each nearby enemy — then start swinging.
rampage.Passive: Fight near the jungle for doubled regeneration; when stunned or rooted, use the free tenacity window to keep swinging.

riktor.Q: Whip shielded enemies first — it deletes the shield before the damage lands — and silence channelled abilities on reflex.
riktor.LMB: Whip between abilities; the heavy melee scaling punishes anyone the chain drags close.
riktor.RMB: Fish from fog or behind minions; a landed hook on their carry wins the fight — never waste it on tanks.
riktor.E: Turn it on while running enemies down or soaking damage — getting hit pulses extra damage automatically.
riktor.R: Suppress the enemy's most dangerous hero mid-fight; the repeated damage plus lockdown lets allies collapse freely.
riktor.Passive: Chain crowd control onto key targets — while stunned or silenced by Riktor their cooldowns freeze, so lock the carry repeatedly.

sevarog.LMB: Swing between ability casts; hammer hits keep the pressure on while Siphon comes back.
sevarog.RMB: Dash through the whole enemy team — the fear scatters them and opens space for allies to collapse.
sevarog.Q: Hit every wave and camp with it to farm Souls, and jab heroes to steal a cut of their maximum health.
sevarog.E: Drop it on retreat paths; chained enemies must eat the stun to leave, so cast it before allies commit.
sevarog.R: Face enemies away from their team and swing — the knock-back isolates a target or clears divers off a carry.
sevarog.Passive: Every ability kill feeds Souls — farm relentlessly early; the stacking health and tier bonuses turn midgame Sevarog into a wall.

shinbi.RMB: Dash through enemies for damage, but keep one of the two charges in reserve to escape.
shinbi.Q: Fire it down the lane to poke and stack her ultimate; the wolf pierces everything, so line up multiple targets.
shinbi.E: Cast right before trades for the shield and speed; stay close so every wolf hit lands on the enemy.
shinbi.R: Spread ability hits to mark several heroes, then activate at full Track stacks so the wolves hit everyone at once.
shinbi.Passive: When the empowered attack is ready, spend it on a hero — 2.5x damage plus mana back wins short trades.
shinbi.LMB: Attack between wolf casts; the on-hit magic damage makes short trades add up while abilities recharge.

kwang.RMB: Cast while holding the blade for the shield in brawls; cast with it planted for true damage instead.
kwang.Q: Throw the sword behind enemies — the tether traps them, and the planted blade opens dash and teleport plays.
kwang.E: Dash near the planted blade to recall it with a knock-up — throw, dash, and the combo starts itself.
kwang.R: Plant the sword deep, then ult to teleport onto the backline and land the heavy slow.
kwang.Passive: Land abilities to stay Energized — the empowered attacks refund cooldowns on hero hits, so weave attacks between every cast.
kwang.LMB: Attack while Energized after ability hits — the lightning-charged swings carry Kwang's trades.

twinblast.LMB: Aim centre-mass so both projectiles land; split shots halve the trade.
twinblast.RMB: Slow chasers or fleeing targets with a grenade, and keep the second charge in reserve for peel.
twinblast.Q: Line it through the wave into the hero — the boosted on-hit effectiveness makes it the trade winner.
twinblast.E: Hit heroes constantly to recharge the dash, and save it for dodging the one ability that kills.
twinblast.R: Unload it on lined-up targets after attack speed items — more attack speed means more bullets.
twinblast.Passive: Cast, then attack — the triple shot plus attack speed makes every ability a damage steroid, so alternate constantly.

aurora.LMB: Attack between casts — the bonus on-hit magic damage makes her short trades sting.
aurora.RMB: Sweep as enemies walk in — the first wave slows so the eruption lands; poke through minions with it.
aurora.Q: Dash in for engages or wall off chases — allies ride the ice with bonus speed; jump to stop mid-dash.
aurora.E: Ring it around a slowed or stunned enemy — touching the edge roots them, so cast it before they move.
aurora.R: Freeze the carry as the fight opens — the slow-then-stun sequence hands the team a guaranteed follow-up.
aurora.Passive: Double-jump out of dives so the Replica eats tower shots, and keep dealing damage to hold the Frost Storm up.

dekker.E: Fence enemies in as allies collapse, or wall out their frontline to split the fight in half.
dekker.LMB: Poke between abilities — the attacks carry solid base damage even on a support budget.
dekker.RMB: Throw the bomb from long range — the stun grows with distance — and bounce it over minions onto carries.
dekker.Q: Sweep the drone's beam through fights, lining it so multiple enemies eat the damage and slow.
dekker.R: Centre the strike on locked-down targets — the middle stuns — so drop it where the fence traps them.
dekker.Passive: Cycle abilities to recharge the boots, then rocket-jump to hand nearby allies a speed burst when chasing or fleeing.

akeron.LMB: Swing constantly — every hit feeds Hunger, marching Akeron toward his Awakened form.
akeron.RMB: Bite point-blank — close targets take extra — and finish kills with it for the boosted heal and instant Awakening.
akeron.Q: Float the Eye into the fight and pause it over their team; the stacking slow herds enemies into the web.
akeron.E: Web a wall above the fight to drop on grouped enemies for the stun, or root the one trying to leave.
akeron.R: Consume when a bitten target is low — each execute permanently banks maximum health, so always hunt the finish.
akeron.Passive: Trade constantly, even taking hits — damage taken feeds Hunger too — and time fights around the Awakened damage-reduction window.

renna.LMB: Keep attacking while abilities recharge; steady ranged hits force enemies away from the Essence on the ground.
renna.RMB: Collect Essence first — more Essence means extra projectiles per swing — then unload the waves into trades.
renna.Q: Throw the orb onto a wounded target; it pulls them in, heals Renna, and executes them at very low health.
renna.E: Shift up over incoming skillshots and drop the orb on divers; the daze buys time to walk away.
renna.R: Channel from safety before teleporting — arrive on top of the fight so the singularity rains on grouped enemies.
renna.Passive: Sweep up Essence after every wave and kill; it powers every ability, and jumping mid-air hovers over ground danger.

gadget.RMB: Reactivate the droid above the enemy carry; it follows and slows them, forcing them out of the fight.
gadget.Q: Stick the mine to a hero, then land a basic attack before it explodes to empower the blast.
gadget.E: Throw the gate behind retreating enemies for the root, or give allies the speed boost to chase or escape.
gadget.R: Drop the dome on grouped enemies in tight spots; it grows over its lifetime, so cast early in the fight.
gadget.Passive: Farm every wave and camp — stacks permanently build magic power — and tag heroes with abilities for the bigger bundles.
gadget.LMB: Basic attack anyone carrying a Sticky Mine — the hit empowers the explosion for far more damage.

adele.LMB: Trade often — the built-in true damage on every swing ignores armor stacking.
adele.RMB: Lash through a line of enemies — the root plus the dash to the farthest target starts every engage.
adele.Q: Daze divers with the double swing, then land the slam — mesmerized enemies ignore slows, so hold those for later.
adele.E: Raise the shield into enemy burst — it casts during other abilities — and let the vine tick while soaking damage.
adele.R: Slam the garden onto grouped enemies — it interrupts casts, roots, and grounds fliers — then fight inside it.
adele.Passive: Tag every enemy in reach — allies deal bonus true damage to thorned targets — so spread hits before the team commits.

zarus.LMB: Keep stabbing between abilities — every hit feeds Gladiator stacks and power.
zarus.RMB: Quick-release the thrust in trades for the cooldown refund; save the full throw for targets below 20% health.
zarus.Q: Raise the shield into big incoming damage — 75% reduction — then swing late for the bigger stun.
zarus.E: Dash to stick to targets with the attack speed, and cast it mid-air for the extra upward hop when chasing.
zarus.R: Leap onto a killable target — a kill inside the Coliseum banks permanent power, so pick victims carefully.
zarus.Passive: Stay in combat to hold 8 stacks; when disengaging, the falling stacks heal, so reset fully before re-engaging.

crunch.RMB: Open with the dash to stick to targets; save the Empowered version for extra reach when chasing or escaping.
crunch.Q: Spend the Empowered version on tanks — true damage to everyone in front makes it the combo finisher.
crunch.E: Slow with the jab first so the rest of the combo lands; Empowered launches enemies for free follow-up.
crunch.R: Repeat whichever ability the fight needs — a second knock-up or true-damage swing — and let the passive healing sustain brawls.
crunch.Passive: Alternate ability, punch, ability; two casts load Turbo, so plan which ability gets the enhanced effect.
crunch.LMB: Basic attack after every ability; the amplified punch adds bonus damage and speeds cooldowns along.

serath.LMB: Attack between casts; the bonus magic on-hit rewards staying glued to one target.
serath.RMB: Clap right after a basic attack — it resets the swing and applies on-hit effects to everyone in front.
serath.Q: Vanish onto a marked target to dodge damage mid-fight; if they die, Serath teleports out instantly.
serath.E: Hover to dodge big abilities, then dive onto the target allies are hitting; never lift off with nowhere to land.
serath.R: Open committed fights in demon form — the burning attacks plus speed let Serath run down the backline.
serath.Passive: After a takedown, grab the visage — free demon form and big cooldown refunds mean chaining straight onto the next target.

sparrow.Q: Rain it on objectives and chokepoints — anyone holding ground eats all 8 hits and the rolling slow.
sparrow.E: Vanish to reset a fight or dodge, then unload — the attack speed window afterwards is when Sparrow kills.
sparrow.R: Stand mid-range and fan the volleys through the whole team — the piercing arrows crit and shred grouped fights.
sparrow.LMB: Stay on one target — repeated hits stack her passive so each arrow lands harder.
sparrow.RMB: Charge it from behind walls — it pierces terrain — and release full-power shots on stacked targets.
sparrow.Passive: Commit to one victim — the stacks fall off in seconds, so switching targets throws away the bonus max-health damage.

yurei.RMB: Open with the triple projectiles to tag Soul Rip onto several enemies, setting up rush resets.
yurei.Q: Kick when surrounded — the heal grows with missing health if a hero is hit, and mid-air casts add a leap.
yurei.E: Rush targets carrying Soul Rip: the cooldown resets and their torn Soul shares every hit with them.
yurei.R: Channel in the middle of a grouped fight — the pull plus the rush reset lets Yurei chain straight onto survivors.
yurei.Passive: After every cast, fire both bouncing ranged attacks before the next ability; they add reach and splash to the combo.
yurei.LMB: Melee swings fill the gaps between casts; cast first so the empowered ranged attacks are always loaded.

feng-mao.LMB: Trade in short bursts — glaive basics between ability swings keep pressure without overcommitting.
feng-mao.RMB: Dash through targets to chunk their current health; a takedown refunds most of it, so chain onto the next victim.
feng-mao.Q: Raise the spellshield into the enemy's key ability — blocking one doubles the passive stat gain for the trade.
feng-mao.E: Duel isolated targets — the swings hit far harder against a single enemy, so pick fights away from waves.
feng-mao.R: Check the execute threshold before slamming — on a low enemy it kills outright and refunds a free recast.
feng-mao.Passive: Hunt different victims early — unique takedowns permanently grow penetration, compounding every later trade.

narbash.E: Toggle Speed to rotate and chase, Healing to sustain the lane — swap constantly to match the moment.
narbash.LMB: Whack anyone who gets close — the clubs hit hard for a support and punish careless divers.
narbash.RMB: Save the drumstick for the enemy standing on an ally — the tiny hitbox rewards close-range, sure-thing stuns.
narbash.Q: Shout while allies run enemies down or flee — the empowered march flips chases in both directions.
narbash.R: Drum in the middle of grouped enemies — the stacked slows become a daze, then the finale knocks everyone up.
narbash.Passive: Stay near the pile — Narbash grows stronger for every hero nearby, so fight in crowds, not empty side lanes.

eden.LMB: Shred from range with the repeater; swap to melee only when the claw chain's heavy finisher can land safely.
eden.RMB: Ranged: thrust away and fire the empowered Railshot. Melee: dash-uppercut a target allies can follow onto.
eden.Q: Ranged: poke down the lane with the piercing laser. Melee: spin through the brawl and finish with the lightning slow.
eden.E: Swap stances constantly — ranged for free power at distance, melee to heal off heroes when diving.
eden.R: Ranged: beam clumped targets from above. Melee: teleport in only when the fight is already committed.
eden.Passive: Keep hitting heroes to hold Heat — pauses drain it — and build toward Overheat right before fights start.

neon.LMB: Weave attacks between abilities; after a dash, the next Jolt carries the real damage.
neon.RMB: Dash sideways, then attack — the empowered Jolt explodes and slows; Overclocked, recast for a free second dash.
neon.Q: Aim it through multiple enemies — it damages going out and returns as true damage, punishing anyone standing in line.
neon.E: Lob it onto fleeing or grouped targets; Overclocked, the daze turns a poke into a pick.
neon.R: Activate before committed fights — every ability upgrades for 8s — and save the recast bomb for low-health targets.
neon.Passive: Count the casts — every third ability Overclocks, so hold the upgraded charge for the ability the fight actually needs.

countess.Passive: Land two ability hits quickly on one hero — the max-health bleed and bonus speed make her all-ins lethal.
countess.LMB: Swing between casts; basic attacks fill the damage gaps while the spin and cloud recharge.
countess.RMB: Spin surrounded by heroes — the healing jumps massively against them — so pop it in the scrum, not on minions.
countess.Q: Dash in, burst, and keep the swap in pocket — returning to the Shadow within its window is the escape plan.
countess.E: Poke through minions with the dark cloud — it travels a path, so line up multiple targets.
countess.R: Feast on a target already bleeding from her passive — the bonus damage plus full-damage heal decides dives.

howitzer.Passive: Casting abilities recharges the empowered shot fast — cycle a spell, then attack a hero for splash damage and mana back.
howitzer.LMB: Keep shooting between spells; steady ranged damage forces enemies off the wave while cooldowns tick.
howitzer.RMB: Scatter the bombs across a choke or under a melee diver — repeated pops keep reapplying the slow.
howitzer.Q: Charge the rocket fully on slowed targets; fire from long range and lead their movement.
howitzer.E: Mine under himself when jumped — the knock-back and stun bounce divers away; reactivate to pop it early.
howitzer.R: Fly up above a locked-down fight and paint grouped targets; save it for enemies stunned by allies.

ikra.LMB: Pop placed Bubbles with basic attacks mid-trade; steady ranged hits keep pressure while cooldowns run.
ikra.RMB: Use it on low minions for the bonus gold, and fire it into Bubbles — popping adds Hydroclasm's damage on top.
ikra.Q: Save it to suspend a diving hero, then land the full combo while they are locked in the sphere.
ikra.E: Place the Bubble on a fight, wait 1.1s so it amplifies, then pop it with Brine for the big slow.
ikra.R: Channel from behind walls — it pierces them; aim where enemies group so the knock-up and slow start the fight.
ikra.Passive: Pick the Eternal category that fits the game plan — sustain, mobility, lockdown, or anti-heal — before locking a build.

scarlett.LMB: Land the third strike — it restores 5 Energy, 10 against heroes, so chain attacks between abilities to stay funded.
scarlett.RMB: Save it to finish — the final stab adds up to 100% bonus damage based on their missing health.
scarlett.Q: Hit with the outer edge, not the middle: it adds damage, slows, and empowers your next Cindara for 4s.
scarlett.E: Dash through several heroes — each hit refreshes the shield, grows it 60%, and returns 50 Energy.
scarlett.R: Open fights with it — you are Unstoppable through the 1.4s restrain, and the Ablaze buff afterwards is the real payoff.
scarlett.Passive: You run on Energy, not mana — takedowns return 100 Energy, and every 35 bonus mana becomes 1 Physical Power.
